judged_text: The diff silently removes the public `--category/-c` CLI option and replaces the permalink-post creation with TopicEmbed.import_remote, changing what the existing disqus import command accepts and produces without any mention in the PR's stated objective. Existing operator scripts invoking `thor disqus import -c 'Some Category'` now abort with a Thor unknown-switch error, and even corrected invocations no longer create the '[Permalink](url)' post with category assignment — instead they fetch each Disqus thread's live URL over HTTP and import the scraped article, silently changing the imported data shape for every existing user of the task.

adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly removes the Thor CLI option `:category` / `-c` from `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` (deleted `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` and all `options[:category]` handling). With this change, `thor disqus import -c 'Some Category'` would now raise an unknown switch error, which is a concrete behavior break introduced by the diff. Additionally, the import behavior changes from creating a post with raw "[Permalink](...)" (and optional category assignment) via `PostCreator` to calling `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, which fetches and imports remote content instead; this is a verified, silent data-shape/behavior change in the task implementation.
